_README: One vocabulary of systems: the rules that turn an application (its process name) and a window title into the name of the business system the work happened in ('Salesforce', 'SAP', 'Excel', 'Outlook'). A browser is only where a web system ran, so a browser window is named by the web system its title names. Read by normalization/app_names.py (system_name, and the per-application names in stats.json meta.app_names) and by the viewer, so both name a system the same way. The rules are ORDERED and the first match wins. A rule matches when the application is one of `process` (lowercase, without '.exe') and, when the rule has a `title`, that regular expression finds a match in the window title, ignoring case (keep it plain: it runs in Python and in JavaScript). A rule without a `title` also names the application itself (meta.app_names). When no rule matches, the application's readable name is used: meta.app_names, else the executable name without '.exe', capitalized when it is all one case. Keep it dependency-free JSON.
